Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta are some of the 170 companies reporting earnings this week after Alphabet and Tesla set the stage last week.  More than 130 S&P 500 companies have already reported earnings, with most beating earnings expectations, but whether those earnings beats translated into a move higher for the stocks was a more complicated story.
